links.outcome: Readability indices of LLM responses to PMOS/PCOS questions across three models
links.effect: DeepSeek-V4 had higher median ARI, GFI, FKGL and SMOG; GPT-5.5 had the highest Coleman-Liau; FRES showed no overall difference (adjusted P = 0.100). Absolute reading grade levels not stated in abstract.
links.quote: DeepSeek-V4 had higher median ARI, GFI, FKGL and SMOG values, whereas GPT-5.5 had the highest median Coleman-Liau score.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of large language models answering patient-facing clinical questions regarding polyendocrine metabolic ovarian syndrome (PMOS/PCOS) without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
